Name: Less Greedy Pierre - Organic Vegetables Event Rewrite
Author: AirynS
Description:
A small mod that edits the Pierre's Prime Produce reward event so that Pierre isn't cartoonishly greedy. Instead, he successfully haggles with Gus to a price both are happy with, then discusses his prices compared to Joja's with Jodi. In general, while he's still trying to make a profit, he's also a reasonable small business owner who recognises that overpricing your goods and wrecking your relationship with your best customers is a stupid business decision.

To install, simply extract the "[CP] Less Greedy Pierre" folder and drop it in your Mods folder.

This mod is i18n-compatible, so if anyone would like to translate it, you're welcome to upload your translation as long as only the translated i18n file is uploaded.

Portrait mod used in screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley.
[/url]
